_notes: Sir 14:22: 思高 verse is compact; Latin has three parallel cola (morábitur / meditábitur / cogitábit) mapped to flex † + mediant * positions. 思高 text used verbatim and split at natural sense divisions. Sir 15:3-6 verse numbering: 思高 splits the Vulgate's verses slightly differently; 15:4 in 思高 matches the content of Vulgate 15:4 (firmábitur/non flectétur/exaltábit) spread across 思高 15:3 end + 15:4; translation follows 思高 content for each Vulgate verse reference. Sir 15:6 ('nómine ætérno hæreditábit illum Dóminus Deus noster'): 思高 15:6 reads '叫他承受名垂千古的基业' which matches the eternal-name/inheritance idea; added '这是我们的上主天主的赐予' to render 'Dóminus Deus noster'. Sir 36 verse numbering: Vulgate 36:1-14 corresponds to 思高 36:1-14 with minor differences in grouping; content matches used. Sir 39:17 'divíni fructus' = '虔敬的子孙' following 思高; the 思高 prefixes '有声音说：' (a voice said) — omitted here as the Vulgate verse itself begins with the address. Sir 36:7 'brácchium dextrum' (right arm): 思高 36:7 reads '显耀你的力量和你的大能' (show your power and might) without specifying right arm; I rendered it closer to the Latin. Canticum Ecclesiastici: rendered as '德训篇赞歌' (Canticle of Sirach/Ecclesiasticus).
